one_chosen_stimulus.false_feedback_guard: Do not admit frames during owned or foreign motion, during return settling, or within the bounded post-action suppression interval. Global camera brightness drift alone is insufficient; never trigger the next gesture from the previous gesture's camera motion.

If a nonzero valid bounded gesture is unavailable, WAIT rather than recenter or loosen limits.

one_chosen_nonverbal_action.normal_completion: Bind action ID/current SDK boot to the actual direct async physical coroutine, its native move-guard entry/exit and finally release. Require fresh actual encoder/target feedback, settled bounded target/return and no later producer writes. Acknowledgement, UUID absence, elapsed duration, proxy future.done or cancellation request alone is not completion.
one_chosen_nonverbal_action.active_STOP: The same SDK owner owns the cancellation and shielded join of that exact native producer even after client disconnect. U135 motion OFF/global STOP must withdraw the event/action grant, enforce physical torque denial, retain unresolved worker identity, and prevent any fresh ON until the real producer is joined/released or the qualified stronger-negative fallback is retained.
one_chosen_nonverbal_action.return: Only a fresh permitted current binding may use U135 measured-current-pose enable/hold. No historical ON restoration. A later human STOP/privacy/owner change/UNKNOWN prohibits return; preserve it. No homing, wake, goto-neutral or body-yaw trajectory.

Implement lightweight perception, event-to-decision binding and attention admission inside this product whole. Sensor processing and decision must not wait for an LLM or speech response. A busy motion lane, stale event or unknown release yields WAIT, not a later replay of an expired event.

Add a separate explicit attention control and honest OFF/active/WAIT/denied/UNKNOWN state to the existing authenticated panel. Default OFF until a fresh permitted attention action; never reinterpret historical speech AUTOoff as an indefinite ON grant or change microphone/camera/mode/volume/AUTO to arm attention.

Qualification uses one bounded observation window up to 300 seconds and at most two admitted sensor-backed attention activities: a completed notice-and-return and an active owned STOP/current-return case. No synthetic frame/event, operator-made environmental stimulus, user QA or forced second event. If real events do not supply the required useful and control evidence by FIRST, close without product PASS.

At closure retain only a current explicitly authorized accepted attention permission and validated dependencies. An absent, withdrawn, expired or ambiguous grant leaves attention OFF/WAIT; it never turns the robot, capture or the rest of the project off on a timer.
